title: Langgu (Beijing) New Material Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Langgu (Beijing) New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel materials company focused on silica aerogel multifunctional materials for buildings, green factories, low-energy public buildings, petrochemical projects, electronics facilities, and new-energy applications. The company combines technology development, standards work, smart production, and project implementation.

Company Overview

Langgu organizes its product offering around aerogel insulation systems, aerogel insulation-and-decoration integrated boards, and functional coating systems. The company publicly highlights intelligent manufacturing, standards participation, patent development, and scale-up through its Tianjin production base.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China, with stated plans to expand toward wider ASEAN markets.
  • Focus Areas: Building insulation, industrial insulation, integrated decorative insulation boards, and aerogel functional coatings.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel insulation materials
  • Aerogel insulation-and-decoration integrated boards
  • Aerogel functional coatings
  • Public Capacity: 200,000 m³ of aerogel composite non-combustible insulation boards and 10,000 tons of functional coatings annually at the Tianjin Wuqing production base.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Intelligent production base in Wuqing District, Tianjin, China; headquarters operations linked to Beijing and Tianjin Eco-City.
  • International Certifications: Public pages emphasize high-tech enterprise recognition, standards participation, and patents; specific international certificate details are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: https://langnm.com/sy
